description: Acqua - Elemento Acquedottistico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by arcgis.com. The nodes of the PARS network are represented by the OST aqueduct element, while the branches of this network are the conduits and sewage collectors. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Water - Aqueduct Element" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Land use, n.d.. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2008-01-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
